room_rent.note: Room rent capped at 1% of Sum Insured per day; associated medical expenses proportionally restricted if higher room taken

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges capped at 2% of Sum Insured per day

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-payment on every admissible claim; can be waived by paying additional optional premium

sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at ₹40,000 per eye per year; Modern treatments capped at 50% of Sum Insured

initial_waiting.note: Except claims arising from accident; 90 days for lump-sum HIV/AIDS benefit

ped_waiting.note: 24 months for pre-existing disability; 36 months for all other pre-existing conditions except HIV/AIDS

specific_disease_waiting.note: 19 listed conditions including cataract, hernia, hydrocele, varicose veins, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity explicitly excluded under standard exclusion Excl18; ectopic pregnancy covered

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration or reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days from discharge

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered; indicative list of 537+ procedures provided in Annexure III

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation expenses explicitly excluded under specific exclusions

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient treatment covered up to 100% of Sum Insured per policy year

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation for donation of body organs by insured explicitly excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursed up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered up to 50% of Sum Insured as inpatient or day care

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical/consumable items excluded under Annexure II

global_cover.note: Medical treatment outside India explicitly excluded under specific exclusions

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except on grounds of fraud; portability/migration credits count

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for annual/quarterly/half-yearly; 15 days for monthly premium mode

free_look.note: Applicable only for new individual policies; not on renewals or policies with tenure less than 1 year

portability.note: Portability to same product of other insurers as per IRDAI guidelines; waiting period credits transferred

notable_exclusions.display: Treatment outside India, organ donor hospitalisation, domiciliary treatment, ART for HIV, STDs, stem cell storage, alternative therapies
